newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Marine delivers coastal tanker.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Marine delivers coastal tanker.

text.p: Keppel Marine Industries said on Tuesday its subsidiary Keppel Singmarine Dockyard Pte Ltd has completed and delivered a clean petroleum product tanker to the United Kingdom.
It said in a statement the coastal tanker "Audacity", with a capacity of 4,250 cubic metres, was delivered to British-based shipping company FT Everard Shipping Ltd.
"Audacity" is the second of the two coastal tankers built by Keppel for FT Everard, a company statement said.
A Keppel spokesman told Reuters the combined contract value for the two tankers was Singapore $34 million.
